SELECT year(date_taken) AS yr, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM jwst_space_images
WHERE year(date_taken) >= 2022 AND year(date_taken) <= 2026
GROUP BY yr
ORDER BY yr

WITH t AS (
  SELECT photo_id, date_taken,
         lag(date_taken) OVER (ORDER BY date_taken, photo_id) AS prev_dt
  FROM jwst_space_images
  WHERE date_taken >= TIMESTAMP '2022-07-12'
    AND date_taken <= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-05'
),
b AS (
  SELECT date_taken,
         SUM(CASE WHEN prev_dt IS NULL OR date_taken - prev_dt > INTERVAL '168' HOUR THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           OVER (ORDER BY date_taken, photo_id) AS burst_id
  FROM t
),
sizes AS (
  SELECT burst_id, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM b
  GROUP BY burst_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_bursts, MAX(n) AS largest_burst_size
FROM sizes

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n
FROM jwst_space_images
WHERE subject = 'nebula'

WITH t AS (
  SELECT photo_id, date_taken, subject,
         lag(date_taken) OVER (ORDER BY date_taken, photo_id) AS prev_dt
  FROM jwst_space_images
  WHERE date_taken >= TIMESTAMP '2022-07-12'
    AND date_taken <= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-05'
),
b AS (
  SELECT photo_id, date_taken, subject,
         SUM(CASE WHEN prev_dt IS NULL OR date_taken - prev_dt > INTERVAL '168' HOUR THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           OVER (ORDER BY date_taken, photo_id) AS burst_id
  FROM t
),
sizes AS (
  SELECT burst_id, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM b
  GROUP BY burst_id
),
biggest AS (
  SELECT burst_id FROM sizes ORDER BY n DESC, burst_id LIMIT 1
)
SELECT MIN(b.date_taken) AS start_dt,
       MAX(b.date_taken) AS end_dt,
       COUNT(*) AS image_count,
       (SELECT subject FROM b WHERE burst_id = (SELECT burst_id FROM biggest)
        GROUP BY subject ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, subject LIMIT 1) AS subject,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM b WHERE burst_id = (SELECT burst_id FROM biggest)
        AND subject = (SELECT subject FROM b WHERE burst_id = (SELECT burst_id FROM biggest)
                       GROUP BY subject ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, subject LIMIT 1)) AS subject_count
FROM b
WHERE burst_id = (SELECT burst_id FROM biggest)

WITH counts AS (
  SELECT instrument, subject, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM jwst_space_images
  WHERE instrument IN ('FGS','MIRI','NIRCam','NIRISS','NIRSpec')
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
totals AS (
  SELECT instrument, SUM(n) AS total
  FROM counts
  GROUP BY 1
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT c.instrument, c.subject, c.n, t.total,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.instrument ORDER BY c.n DESC, c.subject) AS rn
  FROM counts c
  JOIN totals t ON t.instrument = c.instrument
)
SELECT instrument, subject,
       ROUND(n * 100.0 / total, 1) AS pct
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 2
  AND total >= 20
ORDER BY instrument

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n

WITH valid AS (
  SELECT instrument, date_taken
  FROM jwst_space_images
  WHERE instrument IN ('MIRI','NIRCam','NIRSpec')
    AND date_taken >= TIMESTAMP '2022-07-12'
    AND date_taken <= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-05'
),
gaps AS (

top_gap AS (

pct AS (

  FROM jwst_space_images
  WHERE instrument IN ('MIRI','NIRCam','NIRSpec')
  GROUP BY instrument
)
SELECT g.instrument,
       ROUND(g.gap_days, 1) AS gap_days,
       g.date_taken AS gap_end_date,
       ROUND(p.pct, 1) AS pct_spectra_or_plots
FROM top_gap g
JOIN pct p ON p.instrument = g.instrument
ORDER BY g.instrument

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_photos FROM photos

SELECT COUNT(*) AS unlabelled_photos
FROM photos p
LEFT JOIN labels l USING (photo_id)
WHERE l.photo_id IS NULL

WITH matched AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
      WHERE l.subject = CASE p.legacy_tag_label
        WHEN 'galaxy' THEN 'galaxy'
        WHEN 'galaxy cluster' THEN 'galaxy_cluster'
        WHEN 'nebula' THEN 'nebula'
        WHEN 'solar system' THEN 'solar_system'
        WHEN 'star' THEN 'star'
        WHEN 'star cluster' THEN 'star_cluster'
        WHEN 'exoplanet' THEN 'exoplanet'
        WHEN 'deep field' THEN 'deep_field'
        WHEN 'cosmology' THEN 'deep_field'
      END
    ) AS same
  FROM photos p
  JOIN labels l USING (photo_id)
  WHERE p.legacy_tag_label IS NOT NULL
    AND p.legacy_tag_label NOT IN ('unclassified', 'observatory / engineering')
)
SELECT total, same, ROUND(100.0 * same / total, 1) AS pct_same
FROM matched

SELECT COUNT(*) AS v6_labels
FROM labels
WHERE codebook_version = 'v6'

WITH labelled AS (
  SELECT p.photo_id,
         YEAR(p.date_taken) AS yr,
         l.gate_category,
         (pi.photo_id IS NOT NULL) AS published
  FROM photos p
  JOIN labels l USING (photo_id)
  LEFT JOIN jwst_space_images pi USING (photo_id)
  WHERE YEAR(p.date_taken) BETWEEN 2022 AND 2025
)
SELECT yr AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS labelled_count,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT published) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_not_published,
       (SELECT t2.gate_category
        FROM labelled t2
        WHERE t2.yr = t.yr AND NOT t2.published
        GROUP BY t2.gate_category
        ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
        LIMIT 1) AS top_gate_not_published
FROM labelled t
GROUP BY yr
ORDER BY yr

SELECT COUNT(*) AS photos_without_tags

       MAX(date_taken) - MIN(date_taken) AS span_days
FROM jwst_space_images

  AND date_taken IS NOT NULL
  AND date_taken <= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-05'

SELECT object_name_normalized AS object,

       MIN(YEAR(date_taken)) AS first_year,
       MAX(YEAR(date_taken)) AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE instrument IN ('NIRCam','MIRI','NIRSpec','NIRISS','FGS')) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_single_named_instrument

WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT date_taken,
         LAG(date_taken) OVER (ORDER BY date_taken) AS prev_dt
  FROM jwst_space_images
  WHERE date_taken >= TIMESTAMP '2022-07-12'
    AND YEAR(date_taken) <= 2026
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT *,
         CASE WHEN prev_dt IS NULL
                OR date_taken - prev_dt > INTERVAL 7 DAY
              THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_burst
  FROM ordered
),
bursts AS (
  SELECT *,
         SUM(new_burst) OVER (ORDER BY date_taken) AS burst_id
  FROM flagged
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT burst_id) AS num_bursts,
       MAX(cnt) AS largest_burst_size
FROM (
  SELECT burst_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bursts
  GROUP BY burst_id
)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_nebula_images
FROM jwst_space_images
WHERE subject = 'nebula'

WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT photo_id, date_taken,
         LAG(date_taken) OVER (ORDER BY date_taken) AS prev_dt
  FROM jwst_space_images
  WHERE date_taken >= TIMESTAMP '2022-07-12'
    AND YEAR(date_taken) <= 2026
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT *,
         CASE WHEN prev_dt IS NULL
                OR date_taken - prev_dt > INTERVAL 7 DAY
              THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_burst
  FROM ordered
),
bursts AS (
  SELECT photo_id, date_taken,
         SUM(new_burst) OVER (ORDER BY date_taken) AS burst_id
  FROM flagged
),
burst_sizes AS (
  SELECT burst_id,
         COUNT(*) AS image_count,
         MIN(date_taken) AS burst_start,
         MAX(date_taken) AS burst_end
  FROM bursts
  GROUP BY burst_id
),
largest AS (
  SELECT burst_id, image_count, burst_start, burst_end
  FROM burst_sizes
  ORDER BY image_count DESC, burst_start
  LIMIT 1
),
subject_counts AS (
  SELECT b.burst_id, i.subject, COUNT(*) AS subject_count
  FROM bursts b
  JOIN jwst_space_images i ON i.photo_id = b.photo_id
  GROUP BY b.burst_id, i.subject
)
SELECT l.burst_start, l.burst_end, l.image_count, sc.subject, sc.subject_count
FROM largest l
JOIN subject_counts sc ON sc.burst_id = l.burst_id
ORDER BY sc.subject_count DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH per_instr AS (
  SELECT instrument, COUNT(*) AS total
  FROM jwst_space_images
  WHERE instrument IN ('NIRCam','MIRI','NIRSpec','NIRISS','FGS')
  GROUP BY instrument
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT instrument, subject, COUNT(*) AS n,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY instrument ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
  FROM jwst_space_images
  WHERE instrument IN ('NIRCam','MIRI','NIRSpec','NIRISS','FGS')
  GROUP BY instrument, subject
)

WITH bad AS (
  SELECT photo_id FROM jwst_space_images
  WHERE date_taken > TIMESTAMP '2026-10-05' OR date_taken < TIMESTAMP '2021-12-25'
),
win AS (
  SELECT instrument, date_taken,
         LAG(date_taken) OVER (PARTITION BY instrument ORDER BY date_taken) AS prev_d
  FROM jwst_space_images
  WHERE date_taken >= TIMESTAMP '2022-07-12'
    AND date_taken <= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-05'
    AND photo_id NOT IN (SELECT photo_id FROM bad)
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT instrument, date_taken AS gap_end, prev_d,
         DATE_DIFF('day', prev_d, date_taken) AS gap_days
  FROM win
),
top AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY instrument ORDER BY gap_days DESC, gap_end) AS rn
  FROM gaps
  WHERE prev_d IS NOT NULL
),
per_instr AS (
  SELECT instrument, COUNT(*) AS total
  FROM jwst_space_images
  WHERE instrument IN ('NIRCam','MIRI','NIRSpec')
  GROUP BY instrument
)
SELECT t.instrument, t.gap_days AS gap, t.gap_end,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE j.modality = 'spectrum_or_plot') / p.total, 1) AS pct_spectra
FROM top t
JOIN per_instr p USING (instrument)
JOIN jwst_space_images j USING (instrument)
WHERE t.rn = 1
GROUP BY t.instrument, t.gap_days, t.gap_end, p.total
ORDER BY pct_spectra DESC

)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total,

       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE legacy_norm = subject) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_same
FROM matched;

WITH labelled AS (
  SELECT p.photo_id, YEAR(p.date_taken) AS yr, l.gate_category
  FROM photos p
  JOIN labels l ON l.photo_id = p.photo_id
  WHERE YEAR(p.date_taken) BETWEEN 2022 AND 2025
),
published AS (
  SELECT photo_id FROM jwst_space_images
),
not_pub AS (
  SELECT yr, gate_category, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM labelled
  WHERE photo_id NOT IN (SELECT photo_id FROM published)
  GROUP BY yr, gate_category
),
not_pub_ties AS (
  SELECT yr, gate_category,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY yr ORDER BY n DESC) AS rnk
  FROM not_pub
)
SELECT l.yr AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS labelled_count,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.photo_id NOT IN (SELECT photo_id FROM published)) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_not_published,
       (SELECT t.gate_category FROM not_pub_ties t WHERE t.yr = l.yr AND t.rnk = 1 LIMIT 1) AS top_gate_not_published
FROM labelled l
GROUP BY l.yr
ORDER BY l.yr;

SELECT object_name_normalized, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM jwst_space_images
WHERE object_name_normalized IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(object_name_normalized) <> ''
GROUP BY object_name_normalized
ORDER BY count DESC, object_name_normalized
LIMIT 5

WITH cleaned AS (
  SELECT object_name_normalized, date_taken
  FROM jwst_space_images
  WHERE object_name_normalized IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(object_name_normalized) <> ''
    AND date_taken IS NOT NULL
    AND date_taken BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2021-12-25' AND TIMESTAMP '2026-10-05'
),
spans AS (
  SELECT object_name_normalized,
         COUNT(*) AS n,
         MIN(date_taken) AS first_date,
         MAX(date_taken) AS last_date,
         DATE_DIFF('day', MIN(date_taken), MAX(date_taken)) AS span_days
  FROM cleaned
  GROUP BY object_name_normalized
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 4
)
SELECT object_name_normalized, span_days
FROM spans
ORDER BY span_days DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS pillars_images
FROM jwst_space_images
WHERE object_name_normalized = 'Pillars of Creation'

WITH valid AS (
  SELECT object_name_normalized, instrument, date_taken
  FROM jwst_space_images
  WHERE object_name_normalized IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(object_name_normalized) <> ''
    AND date_taken BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2021-12-25' AND TIMESTAMP '2026-10-05'
),
per_obj AS (
  SELECT object_name_normalized,
         COUNT(*) AS image_count,
         MIN(EXTRACT(year FROM date_taken)) AS first_year,
         MAX(EXTRACT(year FROM date_taken)) AS last_year,
         COUNT(DISTINCT EXTRACT(year FROM date_taken)) AS n_years
  FROM valid
  GROUP BY object_name_normalized
),
inst AS (
  SELECT object_name_normalized,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE instrument NOT IN ('unknown', 'multiple', 'non-Webb')) AS n_instrument
  FROM valid
  GROUP BY object_name_normalized
)
SELECT p.object_name_normalized,
       p.image_count,
       p.first_year,
       p.last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * i.n_instrument / p.image_count, 1) AS pct_named_instrument
FROM per_obj p
JOIN inst i USING (object_name_normalized)
WHERE p.n_years >= 3
ORDER BY p.first_year, p.object_name_normalized
